title: Passive Voice Extended
summary: Using passive in Präteritum/Perfekt and with modal verbs in formal or factual contexts.
whyItMatters: Extended passive forms describe past processes, completed results, and requirements while keeping the action or affected object in focus.

mentalModel.title: Tense lives in werden
mentalModel.content: Change the passive auxiliary for time while keeping the lexical participle.

mentalModel.title: Perfekt passive has a special worden
mentalModel.content: Use ist/sind + Partizip II + worden, not geworden.

ruleBlocks.title: Use wurde plus participle
ruleBlocks.content: Use 'Das Bild wurde restauriert' for a completed past process.

ruleBlocks.title: Use sein plus participle plus worden
ruleBlocks.content: Use 'Das Bild ist restauriert worden' in conversational perfect.

ruleBlocks.title: Put werden at the end after a modal
ruleBlocks.content: Use 'Die Übung muss regelmäßig wiederholt werden'.

ruleBlocks.title: Add an agent only when relevant
ruleBlocks.content: Use von for people/institutions and durch for means or causes.

tables.title: Adding Cause or Agent
rows: Das Werk wurde von der Stadt finanziert.
Die Leistung wurde durch Training verbessert.

sentenceStructure: The affected object becomes the grammatical subject.
The participle stays near the clause end.
In modal subordinate clauses, the verb cluster requires special attention.
Omit the agent when unknown or irrelevant.

comparisons.summary: Art, healthcare, and training provide process-focused passive contexts.
Presentations use passive to summarize creation, treatment, and institutional action objectively.

examples.de: Das Gebäude wurde 1998 in ein Museum umgebaut.
examples.en: The building was converted into a museum in 1998.

examples.de: Die Ausstellung ist bereits eröffnet worden.
examples.en: The exhibition has already been opened.

examples.de: Vor der Behandlung muss der Patient untersucht werden.
examples.en: The patient must be examined before treatment.

examples.de: Der Plan wurde durch regelmäßige Tests angepasst.
examples.en: The plan was adjusted through regular tests.

examples.de: Das Projekt ist von mehreren Institutionen unterstützt worden.
examples.en: The project has been supported by several institutions.

commonMistakes.reason: The participle precedes the final passive infinitive.

commonMistakes.wrong: Use passive when the responsible actor is central.
commonMistakes.correct: Use active voice when agency matters most.
commonMistakes.reason: Voice choice should reflect information focus.

tips: Transform one active sentence through four passive tenses.
Ask whether the agent adds useful information.
